headline: Chinese firms cleared to buy banned Nvidia AI chips have empty offices
summary: Two Chinese companies approved to receive Nvidia's banned H200 AI chips, New Matrix and Maginfra, have offices that appear abandoned. People nearby say they are unfamiliar with the firms or have never seen anyone working there, raising questions, per a New York Times report, about how the approved buyers were vetted.
